description: pageColorScheme() golden pairs: given the appearance a page resolved for its own palette, the colour scheme a client should give its web view. 'light'/'dark' pin the view to that mode; 'system' leaves the device to answer prefers-color-scheme (iOS .unspecified, desktop nativeTheme.themeSource='system'). The decision is core/appearance.js; core/test/fixtures.test.js asserts it in JS and mobile/ChelaTests/AppearanceParityTests.swift asserts the Swift adapter reproduces it, so the two clients cannot diverge. Regenerate is manual.
